name: StraitsX Singapore Dollar
who_can_redeem: Eligible verified StraitsX account holders may redeem XSGD for Singapore dollars through supported issuer channels.
redemption_region_notes: Account verification, supported networks, jurisdictional restrictions, and issuer terms apply.
redemption_notes: XSGD is represented as a one-to-one SGD-backed digital payment token. Direct issuer redemption is not necessarily available to every secondary-market holder without onboarding.
summary: StraitsX-issued Singapore-dollar stablecoin backed one-to-one by SGD reserves and supported across multiple public blockchains.
notes: Batch I promotion, launch date strengthened in Batch M from StraitsX's official public-release announcement and fifth-anniversary history. Complete deployment map remains unresolved.

name: JPYC
who_can_redeem: Verified users of JPYC EX may issue and redeem the current JPYC stablecoin one-to-one with Japanese yen, subject to issuer terms.
redemption_region_notes: Japanese identity verification, funds-transfer rules, supported networks, and issuer terms apply.
redemption_notes: This record covers the regulated funds-transfer-service JPYC launched in 2025. Legacy JPYC Prepaid products had a different legal and redemption model and are not silently treated as the same instrument.
summary: Japanese-yen stablecoin issued by registered funds transfer service provider JPYC Inc. through the JPYC EX issuance and redemption platform.
notes: Batch I promotion. The launch date refers to the regulated funds-transfer-service JPYC and JPYC EX product, not the legacy prepaid instrument lineage.

name: GYEN
who_can_redeem: Eligible GMO Trust customers may redeem GYEN during the issuer's wind-down redemption periods, subject to account and timing requirements.
minimum_redemption: 100 JPY under the current fee schedule
redemption_region_notes: Purchases are disabled. Redemption access is subject to the Initial Redemption Period, account eligibility, jurisdictional restrictions, and issuer terms.
redemption_notes: GMO Trust commenced an orderly wind-down effective 2026-05-15. GYEN has not been marked terminated because redemption remains available during the announced period.
summary: Japanese-yen stablecoin issued by GMO-Z.com Trust Company, currently in an orderly wind-down with new purchases disabled and time-limited redemption remaining available.
notes: Canonical launch is 2021-03-01, when GMO Trust began GYEN issuance, redemption, and service through its official site. The May 2021 Binance listing and later network deployments are separate distribution and deployment boundaries. Legacy status uses discontinued for compatibility; precise lifecycle status remains winding_down.

name: Brazilian Digital Token
who_can_redeem: Eligible users may redeem BRZ through Transfero or supported regulated partners, subject to onboarding, network, and jurisdiction requirements.
redemption_region_notes: Availability depends on Transfero onboarding, supported partners, networks, and applicable Brazilian or other jurisdictional rules.
redemption_notes: BRZ is represented as a one-to-one Brazilian-real-backed token. Exact legal issuer allocation across Transfero group entities remains a known unknown.
summary: Brazilian-real stablecoin launched by Transfero in 2019 and backed one-to-one by reserves held through authorized financial institutions.
notes: Batch I promotion. Exact day-level launch date and issuing-entity structure require further legal normalization.

name: BiLira
who_can_redeem: Verified BiLira platform users may redeem TRYB one-to-one for Turkish lira, less applicable fees and subject to issuer terms.
redemption_region_notes: KYC/AML, wallet, platform, Turkish-law, and issuer restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: BiLira's current terms state that one Turkish lira reserve is maintained for each TRYB. The issuer also states that it is not yet licensed as a crypto-asset service provider, e-money institution, or credit institution.
summary: Turkish-lira stablecoin issued by BiLira, contractually backed one-to-one by TRY reserves and redeemable by eligible platform users.
notes: Batch I promotion. Exact launch date and complete deployment map remain unresolved.
